Let the lower-left corner be \((0,0)\). Using the grid, the shaded polygon has vertices  
\[
(0,0),\quad (2,3),\quad (5,4),\quad (3,1).
\]

Using the shoelace formula,
\[
\text{Area}=\frac12\left|
(0\cdot3+2\cdot4+5\cdot1+3\cdot0)
-(0\cdot2+3\cdot5+4\cdot3+1\cdot0)
\right|.
\]
So
\[
\text{Area}=\frac12| (0+8+5+0)-(0+15+12+0)|
=\frac12|13-27|
=\frac12(14)=7.
\]

\[
\boxed{7}
\]

The area of the shaded polygon is \(7\) square units.
